subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 3 of 5 English videos and 4 of 5 Arabic videos. The topics 'Core Team Structure' and 'Super Team Structure' in English, and 'Challenges to Managing a Multiple Team Project' in Arabic, lacked sufficiently relevant candidates that also met the quality gates (view count, duration). For other topics, strong candidates were found, particularly for 'Project Office Structure' and 'Best-Fit Structure' in both languages, with clear, well-produced explainers from reputable channels.

coverage.topic: Challenges to Managing a Multiple Team Project
Challenges to Managing a Multiple Team Project
coverage.note: No candidates directly addressed the challenges of managing multiple teams; most focused on general team leadership and failed the relevance gate.
No candidate specifically explained the 'core vs. extended team' structure while also passing the view count gate.
The term 'Super Team' is non-standard. No candidates covered advanced team scaling frameworks (e.g., LeSS, SAFe) while meeting the view count gate.
